{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of duplicate patient_id values:", data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check sample_seq distribution to confirm re-testing
print("Unique sample_seq values:", data['sample_seq'].unique())

# Check assay_batch unit issue
print("Unique assay_batch values:", data['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check the raw biomarker_final values for batch B
batch_b_values = data[data['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final']
print("Batch B biomarker_final min, max, mean:", batch_b_values.min(), batch_b_values.max(), batch_b_values.mean())

# Check for any obvious outliers in biomarker_final
print("Overall biomarker_final min, max, mean:", data['biomarker_final'].min(), data['biomarker_final'].max(), data['biomarker_final'].mean())"}
